name: Kyrgyzstan (1992–2023)
description: A red field with a yellow sun of forty wavy rays bearing a tunduk, the crown of a yurt, drawn with three crossed beams.
history: The flag adopted on 3 March 1992, the day after Kyrgyzstan joined the United Nations, replacing the Kirghiz SSR flag: the forty rays stand for the forty tribes united by Manas. On 26 December 2023 the wavy rays were straightened, after parliamentarians objected that the sun resembled a sunflower, and the tunduk was redrawn with four beams.

features.role: sun of 40 wavy rays with a tunduk
